description: SG-1 fights the Replicators on Earth and with the Asgard, confronts the consequences of Russia possessing a second Stargate, and becomes increasingly entangled in the Jaffa rebellion and Goa’uld power struggles. The conflict with Apophis and the Tok’ra escalates toward open war.

s04e01.description: Carter helps the Asgard devise a desperate strategy against the Replicators while O’Neill, Daniel and Teal’c hunt surviving machines on Earth.

s04e02.description: A technologically advanced society asks Earth for help in a losing war, but SG-1 discovers that the conflict’s moral lines are very different from what they were told.

s04e03.description: Tok’ra armbands give O’Neill, Carter and Daniel extraordinary strength and speed, then begin failing during a mission they are too confident to abandon.

s04e04.description: Teal’c’s former love arrives claiming she has converted her Goa’uld symbiote, offering the Tok’ra an unprecedented chance to gain an insider.

s04e05.description: A Goa’uld brainwashing technique turns trusted personnel into assassins, and evidence suggests O’Neill and Carter may already be programmed.

s04e06.description: O’Neill and Teal’c become trapped in a repeating ten-hour loop and must learn enough each cycle to stop an Ancient experiment.

s04e07.description: Russia reveals its own Stargate program after its gate becomes locked to a water world whose living ocean begins invading the base.

s04e08.description: An archaeological expedition uncovers primitive Goa’uld symbiotes and the Unas, giving Daniel a dangerous chance to communicate with the Goa’uld’s original hosts.

s04e09.description: SG-1 relocates refugees to a new planet only to discover an automated terraforming ship is about to remake the world for another species.

s04e10.description: The team is brainwashed into believing they are underground laborers, while fragments of their real identities slowly break through.

s04e11.description: A conspiracy theorist knows impossible details about the Stargate and insists he is an alien whose forgotten companions are searching for him.

s04e12.description: A test of Earth’s first Goa’uld-derived fighter goes catastrophically wrong, sending O’Neill and Teal’c on an uncontrolled flight out of the solar system.

s04e13.description: Daniel investigates his former professor’s suspicious death and finds an Egyptian artifact carrying a Goa’uld threat that has been hidden on Earth for decades.

s04e14.description: While Teal’c is captured trying to rally Jaffa rebels, SG-1 works with the Tok’ra to prevent an alliance between Apophis and Heru’ur.

s04e15.description: Hammond abruptly resigns after threats against his family, prompting O’Neill to uncover the political pressure being used to control Stargate Command.

s04e16.description: Nine years in the future Earth seems prosperous under an alien alliance, until Carter discovers the price humanity has unknowingly paid.

s04e17.description: Daniel meets the Harcesis child and is shown a future in which access to Goa’uld knowledge gives him the power to reshape Earth.

s04e18.description: An addictive alien device draws SG personnel into obsessive behavior while Daniel searches for the link between the technology and its abandoned users.

s04e19.description: Carter mentors a brilliant cadet whose arrogance may end her career just as an off-world crisis requires exactly the skills she possesses.

s04e20.description: An electrical life-form enters Stargate Command’s computers and takes control of Carter, forcing the SGC to find a way to communicate before destroying it.

s04e21.description: SG-1 returns to a world where their robotic counterparts are fighting Cronus, forcing the two teams to work together against a common enemy.

s04e22.description: SG-1 and the Tok’ra attempt to move a Stargate into a sun and destroy Apophis’s fleet, but the plan creates consequences no one predicted.
